items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: But Louis Armstrong started playing some figures and hitting those notes so beautifully and high until Rick Sturt was really disappointed.

ctx.x: Uh-huh, right. I'm sure there's something in here. Let me look over my notes.
I'm sure I'll see something. From Rick Sturt.
See, not Rick Sturt. Rick Sturt. Rick Sturt, okay.
